nom: LIERAC Hydragenist Morning Moisturizing Mist, Rose, 1 Fl Oz

avis.texte: Prodotto superiore alle aspettative: idratante ed elasticizzante!
... fühlt sich aber leicht klebrig an auf meiner Haut. Da ich die anderen Lierac-Produkte sehr gut finde, bin ich von diesem besonders enttäuscht.
Muy refrescante e hidratante, huele genial, me encanta el efecto en mi piel.

I think all the products of lierac is perfect for the skin ..But you have to know which one is the best for your skin, I started to see the result after 10 days its very good. Its a serum, directly absorbed, but i think that I still need a moisturizer to put it after
